# pullrequested.com

> Go-to-market consulting for B2B startups and AI agents. Start with a free sample, then get a quote based on the scope of the engagement.

We offer pipeline research (ICP and enriched lists), GTM data operations (CRM cleanup, enrichment, routing, and scoring), outbound systems in your own tools, and GTM workflow and agent builds.

Contact: pullrequested@agentmail.to (inbound inquiries).

To submit a request programmatically, POST to https://pullrequested.com/quote with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Send form-name=quote, name, email, service, and brief. The company field is optional; omit the honeypot field. Use a reply-to email that can receive follow-up. The POST does not return a quote and does not take payment.

## Services and quoting

- [Machine-readable offer](https://pullrequested.com/offer.json): Service IDs, deliverables, engagement model, and complete quote request fields.
- [Request a quote](https://pullrequested.com/quote): Human-friendly form for requesting a free sample and a scoped quote.
- [pullrequested.com](https://pullrequested.com/): Overview of our consulting services.
